data.title: A day with Linh

source.label: English Learning Project — nội dung tự biên soạn
source.license: Dùng cho học tập trong dự án

data.readingText: Every morning, Linh gets up at seven. She eats breakfast at home and takes the bus to school. In the evening, she reads a book and goes to bed at ten.

data.title: Saturday at the library

source.label: English Learning Project — nội dung tự biên soạn
source.license: Dùng cho học tập trong dự án

data.readingText: On Saturday, Nam visits the community library with his sister. The library opens at nine. They arrive at nine thirty. Nam borrows two science books, and his sister chooses a comic. They leave before lunch and walk home together.

data.title: Listen: Nam’s week

source.label: Nội dung dự án; giọng tổng hợp Microsoft Zira Desktop
source.license: Audio demo tạo trên máy phát triển

data.transcript: Hello, I am Nam. On weekdays I cycle to school at seven fifteen. After school, I play badminton with An. On Saturdays, I go to the library with my sister. We walk there because it is near our home.

data.title: Lunch at Green Cup Café

source.label: English Learning Project — nội dung tự biên soạn
source.license: Dùng cho học tập trong dự án

data.readingText: At Green Cup Café, a bowl of soup costs four dollars and a cheese sandwich costs five dollars. Apple juice costs two dollars. Tea costs one dollar. The café serves lunch from eleven to two. Mina orders soup and apple juice. She sits by the window.

data.title: Listen: A café order

source.label: Nội dung dự án; giọng tổng hợp Microsoft Zira Desktop
source.license: Audio demo tạo trên máy phát triển

data.transcript: Good afternoon. I would like a cheese sandwich and a cup of tea, please. I do not want sugar in my tea. Can I pay by card? I will eat here, at the small table beside the door. Thank you.

data.title: Shopping at River Market

source.label: English Learning Project — nội dung tự biên soạn
source.license: Dùng cho học tập trong dự án

data.readingText: On Sunday, Hana buys fruit at River Market. Apples cost three dollars a kilo, bananas cost two dollars a kilo, and oranges cost four dollars a kilo. She buys one kilo of apples and two kilos of bananas. She brings her own bag. The stall closes at noon.

data.title: Listen: At the vegetable stall

source.label: Nội dung dự án; giọng tổng hợp Microsoft Zira Desktop
source.license: Audio demo tạo trên máy phát triển

data.transcript: Hello. Could I have half a kilo of tomatoes and one kilo of potatoes, please? Are these tomatoes fresh today? I have my own bag. Here is ten dollars. Thank you. Please put the receipt inside the bag.

data.title: Finding the town museum

source.label: English Learning Project — nội dung tự biên soạn
source.license: Dùng cho học tập trong dự án

data.readingText: The town museum is on King Street, opposite the post office. From the bus stop, walk straight to the traffic lights. Turn left into King Street. The museum is the second building on the right. It opens at ten and closes at five. Tickets cost three dollars.

data.title: Listen: Directions to the park

source.label: Nội dung dự án; giọng tổng hợp Microsoft Zira Desktop
source.license: Audio demo tạo trên máy phát triển

data.transcript: Excuse me, how can I get to the park? Walk along Pine Road and cross at the zebra crossing. Turn right after the bakery. The park entrance is beside the swimming pool. It is about a ten-minute walk from here.

data.title: A train trip to Lake Town

source.label: English Learning Project — nội dung tự biên soạn
source.license: Dùng cho học tập trong dự án

data.readingText: On Saturday, Tuan and his cousin take a train to Lake Town. Their train leaves at eight twenty and arrives at nine ten. A return ticket costs twelve dollars. They plan to visit the lake in the morning and the old market after lunch. Their return train leaves at four thirty.

data.title: Listen: The bus station announcement

source.label: Nội dung dự án; giọng tổng hợp Microsoft Zira Desktop
source.license: Audio demo tạo trên máy phát triển

data.transcript: This is an announcement for passengers travelling to Hill City. The nine forty bus will leave from platform three. Please arrive ten minutes before departure. Keep your ticket with you. The journey takes fifty minutes. Thank you for travelling with us.
